summary: Full-stack round 1 for NEST INFRA CRM. Backend: created pytest suite (71 tests, 4 files) covering auth/RBAC, projects/agents/teams CRUD, sales+commission+payment lifecycle, salary, expenses, dashboard, accounts summary, all 9 reports (json/csv/xlsx) and bulk upload preview/confirm -> 69 passed / 2 failed (97%). Frontend: Playwright E2E as admin and agent (NIA001) plus mobile 390x844 -> admin login/dashboard/KPIs/chart/top agents+teams OK; all 12 nav pages render error-free; new sale auto-updated inventory (115->114 avail, 5->6 booked), auto-computed commission (agent 2% + GV 10,000 fixed = 30,000; team leader 0.5% = 5,000), auto-created booking payment; duplicate plot rejected with toast; final payment flipped Booked->Sold and moved inventory booked->sold; commission Pay Agent worked (pending 5,000->0); salary net = 40k+5k-3k = 42,000; expense add updated summary cards; Accounts 2026-08 numbers consistent (profit = collections - commission - salary - expenses); Reports table + CSV(667B)/XLSX(5.4KB) downloads + profit-summary 4 rows; Admin Upload CSV preview/confirm imported 2 expenses and flagged duplicate salary row. Agent RBAC fully enforced in UI+API. All test data created was cleaned up; seed state restored.

minor.issue: Playbook deviation: login never sets an httpOnly cookie (Set-Cookie empty). Token is returned in body only and the frontend keeps it in localStorage (XSS-exposed). get_current_user already reads request.cookies['access_token'], so only the login/logout response needs to set/clear the cookie (secure, httponly, samesite).
Playbook deviation: no brute-force protection. 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401; expected lockout/429 after 5 failures.

Confirm step re-validates only required fields, not duplicates. Salary/projects/teams rows flagged as duplicates in preview will still be inserted if posted to confirm (UI filters them, API does not).
No pagination/limit; endpoints load whole collections into memory (to_list(None)). Fine for seed data, will degrade with volume.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Other' bucket math is wrong: other = total - marketing - projectExp double-subtracts rows that are both marketing-category AND project-linked (e.g. Google Ads 50,000 tagged to Nest Lake View). Observed Total 1,59,111 / Marketing 86,111 / Project 50,000 / Other 23,000 while the true non-marketing non-project sum is 73,000; the four cards do not reconcile.

Recent Sales / Recent Payments DataTables are 587px wide inside the 390px viewport, causing 213px of page-level horizontal scroll (whole layout drifts sideways). The grid children need min-w-0 (or the table wrapper needs w-full overflow-x-auto with min-w-0) so the table scrolls internally like on Sales/Payments pages.

issues: Recharts console warning on first paint: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — ResponsiveContainer mounts before the h-72 wrapper has size; set minHeight/aspect or render after layout to silence it.
Month filter stays enabled for 'Monthly Profit Summary', but that report ignores the month and always returns every month — either disable the month input for profit-summary or honour the filter.
Empty native <input type="month"> renders as '-------' placeholder which looks broken; consider defaulting to the current month (as Salary/Expenses/Accounts do) or labelling it 'All months'.

action_items: Set httpOnly/secure/samesite access_token cookie on POST /api/auth/login and clear it on /logout (backend already accepts cookie auth); keep Bearer fallback for the SPA.
Fix Expenses 'Other' card computation so Marketing + Project + Other == Total (exclude marketing rows from projectExp or compute other by explicit category/project predicate).
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on Dashboard recent-sales/recent-payments tables (add min-w-0 to grid children).
Re-check duplicates server-side inside /api/admin/upload/{entity}/confirm for salary/projects/teams.
Optional: disable the month filter for the profit-summary report or apply it.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login returns the JWT in the body only; the httpOnly-cookie path in get_current_user is dead code today — align the two.

transactions.compute_commission treats a 'project' level rule with an empty project_id as applying to every project and adds it to the AGENT bucket; make the level/scope semantics explicit or validate project_id when level == 'project'.

insights.build_report loads all sales + payments (and, for profit-summary, per-month salary/expense queries in a Python loop) on every request — move month aggregation to a single Mongo aggregation pipeline before data grows.
uploads.insert_row bypasses the duplicate checks done in upload_preview; the confirm endpoint should re-run the same duplicate detection to stay idempotent.

Verified after cleanup: Green Valley 115/5/0/120, Lake View 95/3/2/100, Sunrise 76/1/3/80, Aug-2026 expenses 1,48,000 and salaries 2,98,000 (original seed values).
test_credentials: Admin nestinfradevelopers39@gmail.com / Admin@123; Agent NIA001 / nest@123 (both verified working). bcrypt hash verified to start with $2b$; seed_admin correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes; CORS_ORIGINS is explicit (no wildcard) with allow_credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q`). Only 2 known failures, both intentional playbook checks: test_login_sets_httponly_cookie and test_brute_force_lockout — they should pass once auth is hardened. Tests are self-cleaning but use unique plot numbers (uuid) for sales; never reuse a fixed plot number. Frontend flows already verified end-to-end: admin dashboard, projects+detail dialog/map link, sale create/duplicate/delete, payment -> Sold flip, commission payout, salary, expenses, accounts, reports (incl. CSV/XLSX download via page.expect_download), admin bulk upload (write CSV to /tmp then set_input_files on [data-testid=upload-file-input]), agent RBAC + direct-URL guards, mobile drawer. When asserting mobile drawer nav use .last on [data-testid=nav-*] (the hidden desktop sidebar node is .first).
rca_of_the_issue: Expenses 'Other': computed as total - marketing - projectExp, but the marketing and project sets overlap (a Google Ads expense linked to a project is counted in both), so the overlap is subtracted twice and Other under-reports by that amount. Mobile overflow: DataTable's overflow-x-auto wrapper sits inside a CSS grid column whose default min-width:auto lets the nowrap table expand the column to 587px, so the overflow escapes to <html> instead of scrolling inside the card; adding min-w-0 to the grid item fixes it (the Sales/Payments pages, where the table is a direct full-width child, show 0px page overflow).
